groups.rationale: Antithesis run 6993853f surfaced a backup coordinator that published completed_at before started_at after a backward wall clock step; 17-reference records the fix and the backup-operators regression test, scenarios.json and 19-coverage list that test as present unit evidence. Antithesis run 6890e160 showed the hosted VM has one logical CPU so measured headroom never frees a whole core; 17-reference now states the admission-stub profile reports a labelled STUB one-core CPU budget capped by measured cgroup cores with memory still measured. The guest-lifecycle workload logs a fixed per-dimension capacity reason. No native, production clock or capacity evidence is claimed.
